Do you want an estimate of the Full Review Fee for this case?

- [ ] Yes (if the case is eligible based on the Preliminary Review, Capitol Bridge will provide an estimate before accepting the case for review)

- [ ] No (if the case is eligible based on the Preliminary Review, Capitol Bridge will accept the case, issue a recommendation and include an invoice for the cost of a Full Review)

## IF THE FILING PARTY IS A PROVIDER: Set forth your position regarding the claim(s)

1. Describe with all appropriate technical detail the basis for and amount of payment you believe you should have received for these services.
2. Provide specific references to the contract, provider manual and other supporting documentation to support your position. Provide all referenced materials.
3. State your understanding of the basis for the claim calculation and payment made by the Health Plan. Provide your rebuttal argument against the Health Plan's calculation.

## IF THE FILING PARTY IS A HEALTH PLAN: Set forth your position regarding the claim(s)

1. Describe with all the appropriate technical detail the basis for the determination that an overpayment was made for these services and the amount of that overpayment.
2. Provide specific references to the contract, provider manual and other supporting documentation to support your position. Provide all referenced materials.
3. State your understanding of the basis for the claim calculation made by the Provider in denying that an overpayment was made. Provide your rebuttal argument against the Provider's calculation.

*Documentation that Provider is licensed in the state of Florida

## Eligibility Attestation:

To be completed by the owner, officer director, or other legally authorized representative of the Filing Party. (Please check all that apply to this claim)

I certify that I am legally authorized to complete this attestation on behalf of the Filing Party. I further certify that this Claim meets all of the following criteria that have been checked:

This claim is not related to an interest payment.

This claim is not related solely to an issue of prompt payment.

This claim is not a part of an internal grievance in a Medicare Managed Care Organization or a reconsideration appeal through the Medicare reconsideration process.

This claim is not a part of a Medicaid fair hearing pursued under 42 CFR §431.220 et seq.

This claim is not the basis for an action pending in state or federal court.

This claim is not subject to a binding claim dispute resolution process provided by contract entered into prior to October 1, 2000.

This claim is not subject to an internal dispute resolution process provided by contract entered into or renewed on or after October 1, 2000 or this claim is subject to such a process, which has been exhausted.

No more than 12 months have elapsed since the final determination was made on this claim.

Claim is being filed by a Rural Hospital, attach documentation demonstrating that the hospital meets the definition of a Rural Hospital under Chapter 395.602(2)(3), Florida Statutes.

Certification: (to be completed by the owner, officer, director, or other legally authorized representative of the Filing Party)

I certify that I am legally authorized to complete this certification on behalf of the Filing Party. I further certify that I understand and agree that if the Filing Party does not prevail it will be responsible for the full or apportioned review costs of this case; that is those costs are not paid within 35 days after the Agency's final order, it will be subject to a fine; and that if this case is settled prior to the time a decision is rendered, the parties will be responsible for the review costs for this case incurred prior to the settlement. I also certify that I understand and agree that the Filing Party will be responsible for the initial review fee.
